title: Cleaning day
scene: It is Saturday, and Max's flat is a mess, so he hires a cleaner and turns on his robot vacuum. They put plastic in the recycling and food scraps in the compost, keep leftovers in a container, run the washing machine on a short cycle with detergent, fill the soap dispenser, change the coffee filter, use a spray on the windows and test the fire alarm.

title: A weekend at the dacha
scene: Grandma's cottage at the dacha has a veranda, a hammock and a garden with a funny gnome. Grandma buys seeds at the garden center, sprays insecticide on her dahlias, irises and azaleas, the jasmine and the magnolia smell sweet, Anna turns on the sprinkler, and they play badminton.

title: Taras wants a pet
scene: Taras wants a pet. At the pet shop they look at an aquarium with koi and a green iguana, and at a chihuahua, a terrier and a poodle with a microchip; the seller explains each dog's temperament.

title: Games night at Grandma's
scene: On Friday the family plays games at Grandma's: a big puzzle, a crossword, bingo, mahjong and ping-pong in the basement. Grandpa always has the joker, plays a clever gambit and wins every chess endgame, and Grandma reads tarot cards and everyone's horoscope.

title: Anna babysits
scene: Anna babysits the neighbors' kids. They plan activities: the kids dress up as a pirate and an angel, are afraid of monsters and zombies, play with stickers and glitter, ride the carousel, and at a birthday party a clown brings a pony.

title: Max on a dating app
scene: Max is single and tries a dating app. He updates his profile, writes about sex and love, has a crush on a sexy girl from his gym, plans a rendezvous, sees his ex, a narcissist, on the app and learns what a red flag is - he still dreams of a real love story.

title: Sofia's coming out
scene: Max's sister Sofia tells the family about her coming out: she is queer and introduces her partner. Grandma asks questions about gender and LGBT people, the family talks about stereotypes and taboos, and they learn to show respect.

title: Cousin Olya's wedding
scene: Anna's cousin Olya gets married. An event coordinator plans the banquet and the catering, the bride wears a tiara, a guest films everything with a video camera, the groom's Scottish friend in a kilt makes a speech and acts like a buffoon, and a DJ plays a waltz; Grandma remembers the big parties for the new millennium, and Olya says she will remember this day forever.

title: Max's job interview
scene: Max applies for a part-time job at an IT company because he wants to become a software engineer. The recruiter and the interviewer ask about his skills and soft skills and every aspect of the job; Max shows his portfolio in a new blazer, and two days later he gets an offer and signs a contract.

title: Max's first day at the office
scene: On his first day Max comes to the office, gets a badge from HR and meets his boss, the office manager and the assistant. He learns about the dress code, and the training starts at ten in the meeting room.

title: A new project
scene: It is a busy period at work: the team leader starts a project for a big client, and the manager gives Max his first task. He explains the deadline, writes every milestone on the team wiki and in a checklist, and Max's enthusiasm is so big that three reminders for one meeting feel like overkill.
